decisions.reason: The required About-page block-prize copy update is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The Big Block change to 3 winners every 35,000 sales is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the $6,000 amount remains unchanged.
The Small Block change to 3 winners every 750 sales is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the $900 amount remains unchanged.
Changing block-prize winner counts and draw frequency does not alter the current or planned product names.
The prize-structure change does not alter how book access, referral identity, badges, or active and expired tickets behave when an NFT is transferred.
The source changes block-prize parameters but leaves the coded-referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, timing, and distribution unchanged.
The source changes prize quantities and draw intervals but does not change Chainlink VRF, on-chain selection, fairness, or its applicability to both draws.
The source explicitly retains the net amount awarded and does not change the mint price, commission, founder share, or prize-pool destinations.
The source changes draw parameters but does not remove either ticket counter or alter badges, referral-code metadata, or other currently required metadata fields.
The block-prize structure change does not affect the Transak provider, fiat methods, USDC conversion, email access, or wallet and cryptocurrency prerequisites.
The source changes winner counts and draw frequency but does not resolve or modify whether prize payouts use manual claims or automatic payout.
The source does not change the $48 flat secondary-sale royalty or its disclosure and enforcement semantics.
